New parents · in French

Baby tracker

Breastfeeds (left, right or both) and bottles, sleep with a timer that runs offline, nappies, weight, length and head circumference, notes and appointments, logged one-handed on your phone and on the other parent's, with entries merged when you both log at once. Daily totals and averages without any comparison to a norm, the measurements you entered plotted by age with no reference curve, and a printable summary for the doctor's appointment. Nothing is saved before your explicit consent; data hosted in the EU. A note-taking tool, not medical advice. Interface in French.
